content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx/error rate detected for hosted inference endpoint: /v1/generate (us-west1). Error rate spike ~12% over the last 3m. Severity: S2. Paging primary on-call.

alice_oncall: I'm on it, paging pager now. seeing increased latency + OOM-ish logs on several pods. grabbing recent replicas and health.

ben_sre: @alice_oncall thx — keep us posted. if it's a kernel/OOM we may need to scale or failover to dedicated pool.

alice_oncall: root cause investigation steps so far:
- checked infra-monitoring: CPU ok, memory high on 3/10 pods
- app logs show repeated "CancelledDuringExecution" and "kv-cache-miss" lines
- quick check: autoscaler hasn't scaled due to a bug in pod selector label.

cara_support: Customer-facing impact? any active customer requests failing?

alice_oncall: ~10% of requests in us-west are returning 5xx (model runtime). No global impact. Customers on dedicated/private not affected.

incident-bot: Suggested play: 1) enable fallback model variant for us-west route 2) toggle prefix-KV caching off 3) open vendor escalation if infra hints to cloud.

alice_oncall: Doing staged fallback now: switching routing policy for us-west to fallback-model:v0.9 for new requests, keeping slow requests routed original. Applying canary for 20% of traffic.

[1m later]

alice_oncall: Canary looks good — errors down to ~3% on canary. rolling to 70%. leaving root for postmortem.

elaine_cs: drafting status page + customer notification. dropping templates here for review.

elaine_cs: STATUS PAGE DRAFT:
```
Summary: We are investigating elevated error rates for Redwood hosted inference in the us-west region affecting /v1/generate. Impact: ~10% of requests in the region may return 5xx errors or time out. Mitigation: Traffic has been partially routed to a fallback model variant; we are monitoring to return to normal. ETA to resolution: ongoing. Updates: every 15 minutes.```

elaine_cs: CUSTOMER NOTIFICATION (concise email/snippet):
```
Hi <Customer>,

We are currently investigating increased error rates affecting requests to our hosted inference endpoint in the us-west region. Some API calls may return 5xx errors or experience higher latency. We have applied a mitigation routing traffic to a fallback model variant to reduce failures. We will provide updates every 15 minutes and will follow up when fully resolved.

If you observe degraded behavior please reply to this thread or reach out to support@redwood.ai with your request id and region.

Thanks,
Redwood Support```

ben_sre: edits: change "ETA to resolution" to "ongoing; next update in 15 minutes". add link to status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1968009999

alice_oncall: updated status page and sent customer notification bundle to queued outgoing list (support-queued).

incident-bot: Action items created: incident:1968009999 -> triage, customer-comms, vendor-escalation.

alice_oncall: raising vendor escalation — @dmitri_cloud_ops please open a priority ticket with GCP: observed repeated "CreateContainerConfigError" / "OOMKilled" events on node pool, autoscaler not scaling due to label mismatch. Requesting urgent node-pool inspection and ephemeral kernel log collection.

@dmitri_cloud_ops: Opening P1 with GCP now. Creating case and attaching logs. Call scheduled in 10m with on-call GCP engineer. Will paste case ID here.

gcp-escalation-bot: Case created: GCP-CASE-2026-44721. Priority: P1. Initial finding: potential node-level memory pressure localized to node pool "redwood-shared-west1".

dmitri_cloud_ops: GCP asked for kubelet logs and dmesg from affected nodes — collecting and uploading to case. Also asked whether workload has sudden traffic or heavier sequences.

alice_oncall: FYI: recent model rollout included a long-prefill path that increases KV cache retention; might increase memory per-request. I've rolled back that rollout on the hosted catalog as a precaution (config change: model-serving.prefill=false).

cara_support: Notifying enterprise customers with support SLAs now — using the template above and adding specific customer request ids if they reported incidents.

[handoff note]
ben_sre: I'm taking on-call at 03:00 UTC in 20m. @alice_oncall - will you hand off current context?

alice_oncall: Handing off: mitigation applied (fallback model routing at 70%), autoscaler bug identified (label mismatch), rollback prefill flag, vendor case GCP-CASE-2026-44721 open, error rate reduced from 12% -> 3% across canary. Logs and dmesg uploaded to case. Next steps: monitor, coordinate with GCP for node-level remediation, patch autoscaler label bug in next deploy.

ben_sre: Got it. I'll keep status updates and convene for postmortem tomorrow. Adding postmortem owners: ben_sre, alice_oncall, dmitri_cloud_ops, cara_support.

incident-bot: Reminder: create an incident severity timeline and attach relevant traces/alerts. Use channel #postmortems when filing.

elaine_cs: Final short customer update going out now: "Mitigation in place. Errors reduced significantly. Monitoring for stability. We will follow up with a full post-incident report."

alice_oncall: thumbs. marking primary mitigated. keeping channel open until GCP confirms node recovery.

[later — 03:12 UTC]

dmitri_cloud_ops: GCP confirmed one node had a memory leak causing kubelet restarts; they replaced the node and drained pods. Recommending we patch prefill code path to avoid unbounded KV retention and bump node-pool memory for next deploy.

ben_sre: Thanks — closing incident as mitigated. Postmortem owners please grab logs and start timeline.

cara_support: Sending final customer follow-up: "This issue has been mitigated and traffic has recovered. We will publish a post-incident report with root cause and remediation within 48 hours."

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: mitigation confirmed; monitoring. Please file postmortem transcript and link to case GCP-CASE-2026-44721.

[reactions: :white_check_mark: from cara_support, :eyes: from alice_oncall, :memo: from ben_sre]
